errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart where each color corresponds to a country series across years, but "Китай/континентал" is not the exact legend label shown; it appears as "Китай/континентален/". Also, the description implies the bars themselves represent countries, whereas the grouping by year is the main structural organization.
The bars are not arranged in alphabetical order; within each year the groups appear in a fixed legend order, and the x-axis categories are years from 2013 to 2022.
